scope: Issue 36 source-only modularization; related reusable-include requirements from issue 32.
gate: Identical complete ROM bytes, symbol names/values and bank layout for each matching profile. No new instructions, buffers, RAM/VRAM/ROM, stack, synchronization or mapper/VDP traffic.

common.linking: INCLUDE at the established position exactly once. Global/local label scope and code/data order are part of the ABI. No MODULE scope, dispatcher, trampoline or function-pointer table is added.
common.stack: Existing CALL/PUSH/interrupt stack behavior only. Balanced returning entries preserve SP. Tail transitions may enter the documented host state machine instead of returning immediately.
common.registers: Unless an entry states a stronger guarantee, callers save AF/flags, BC, DE, HL, IX and IY. No alternate-register preservation is promised across native/host calls.
common.reentrancy: Foreground only, non-reentrant. IRQ must preserve live registers, Page0/Page2 mapping and any foreground VDP/PSG transaction ownership.
common.assets: Host supplies compatible generated assets, bank constants and RAM/VRAM ownership. No original game bytes are distributed by this interface.
common.costs: Use the ROM-bound cycle ledger for the exact workload. Inclusive parent and child costs overlap. The structural extraction adds zero cycles and zero storage, verified by ROM/map identity.

modules.inputs: B=1..255, C=VDP data port, HL=readable source. Caller has already selected the VDP write address and mapped the source bank.
modules.outputs: B=0; HL advances by input length; C unchanged. Exactly that many bytes go to the VDP data port.
modules.registers: AF/flags scratch; B consumed; HL advanced. C, DE, IX, IY preserved.
modules.interrupts: No DI/EI; IFF unchanged. IRQ must not change the source mapping, C or the VDP data pointer.
modules.memory: Code only. No scratch RAM, buffers, VRAM reservation, mapper writes or address setup.
modules.reuse: Independent mechanism. Include directly in another host with a compatible MSX VDP stream and source lifetime. B=0 is outside this API.

modules.inputs: MapPage: A=0/1 RAM map index. CopyMap: A=ASCII16 ROM bank, C=destination RAM segment. PatchObject: B=world X, C=world Y, IY=nine row-major IDs; valid 3x3 region in a 128x256 map.
modules.outputs: MapPage selects the indexed Page0 segment. RestorePage0 selects main segment. CopyMap copies 16 KiB and restores main Page0, leaving its source Page2 bank. PatchObject writes nine IDs, advances IY by nine and C by three, and restores Page0.
modules.registers: MapPage: AF scratch, HL preserved. Restore: AF scratch. CopyMap: AF/BC/DE/HL scratch. PatchObject: AF/BC/DE/HL/IY scratch, IX preserved.
modules.interrupts: IFF unchanged; helpers execute from resident code. IRQ cannot assume another Page0 segment or change mappings.
modules.memory: Host-provided GameSession_MainSegment byte and GameSession_MapSegments pair; no allocation. Uses mapper port FC and ASCII16 register 7000.
modules.reuse: Mechanism with fixed 128x256 map geometry. Another host can define the two state aliases at assembly time; never execute these helpers from the Page0 segment being replaced.

modules.inputs: register: A=value, B=register number; caller serializes the two-port control latch. Wait: no input; only cold UI/transition use.
modules.outputs: register writes one VDP register. Wait returns when command-engine busy clears, with R15=0.
modules.registers: AF/flags scratch; BC/DE/HL/IX/IY unchanged.
modules.interrupts: register preserves IFF. Wait uses DI, polls status 2, restores selector 0 and returns EI; it is not an IRQ-safe primitive or an IFF-preserving lock.
modules.memory: Code only, ports 99; no new scratch. Wait may block and must not be inserted into active gameplay.
modules.reuse: Independent mechanism with the existing host reg macro. Define an equivalent immediate-register macro; preserve the established instruction expansion.

modules.inputs: Prepared native events/actors, world-ID ring, camera/phase state, generated map/terrain/transition tables. Init precedes foreground Prepare/render; commit owns publication.
modules.outputs: Updates existing inactive patterns/names, dirty queues, smoke candidates and radar; no visible-set writes are authorized.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI; GameDirty_Mark and smoke mark hooks retain their stronger adjacent preservation contracts.
modules.interrupts: Host owns foreground/blanking schedule. Existing VDP helpers may DI/EI; no concurrent VRAM writer unless its pointer is restored.
modules.memory: Existing C080/C096/C0B0 state, Page0 radar/dirty/smoke fields at 2300..281F, D800 ring and renderer metadata. All aliases and ranges remain in their owner includes.
modules.reuse: Assembly-time composition, not a game-independent drop-in. Supply matching world/actor/event adapters and packed SCREEN4 layout. First-stage four-set and full-session eight-set profiles are distinct ABIs.

modules.inputs: Game_Frame: A=elapsed native ticks. Init: relocated E000 seed, navigation and main Page0 RAM installed; generated game-config, multi and host bindings available.
modules.outputs: Native state, camera and actor records advance using the original rules; Game_Frame returns with GAME_NATIVE_BANK mapped.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI; host/native callbacks must obey their existing adjacent contracts.
modules.interrupts: Foreground only. IRQ preserves live registers and mappings. No VDP writes in the simulation core itself.
modules.memory: Existing C040..C07F/core aliases, E000..EFFF relocated native state and Page0 navigation. Original memory lifetimes remain required.
modules.reuse: Game-specific native binding. Another port must replace native entry points/state/event adapters at assembly time; the current arcade layout is not a generic API.

modules.inputs: Eight six-byte records: signed16 X, signed16 Y, animation 0..11, kind player/enemy/inactive. Install compatible two-plane templates and palette. Init -> (Prepare -> Commit)*; cy is the next R23 epoch.
modules.outputs: Complete car patterns, mode-2 colors and world SAT slots 14..31. Existing culling/sentinel behavior remains; GS_Culled reports exhausted sentinel tails.
modules.registers: AF/BC/DE/HL/IX/IY caller-saved.
modules.interrupts: Init requires DI/display off; Prepare preserves entry IFF; Commit is called DI in blanking. IRQ must preserve foreground VDP pointer ownership.
modules.memory: Actors C800..C82F, caches C840..C8C1, scratch C980..CD6A. VRAM patterns 2800..2C7F, world colors 18E0..19FF and SAT 1A38..1A7F. Full-session shared poses also retain 2E40..2FFF. HUD slots/patterns remain separate.
modules.reuse: Mechanism with an explicit actor/template/palette ABI. Keep 16x16 unmagnified sprites, R18=0, R23=cy, sentinel compensation, full drawings and real eight-sprites-per-scanline limits.

modules.inputs: Init then Tick once per elapsed nominal 60 Hz tick, A=current Page2 bank; Event A=GameAudio_EVENT_*; generated music/noise data precedes code.
modules.outputs: PSG serviced at 30 Hz; Tick restores its input bank. Stop silences channels and clears requests.
modules.registers: AF/BC/DE/HL caller-saved; IRQ must preserve live registers.
modules.interrupts: No DI/EI; IFF preserved. IRQ must not write PSG or mapper during worker access.
modules.memory: Resident 4000..7FFF code, generated score packets in GAME_AUDIO_BANK, private DC00..DC52 state. No native state reads.
modules.reuse: Portable event/packet adapter with compatible generated tables. Mutually exclusive with native session audio: identical label names do not imply identical event or Tick semantics.

modules.inputs: Include before the native full-session resident/cold bindings.
modules.outputs: Existing EQU aliases only; no reservation or initialization is emitted.
modules.registers: Not executable.
modules.interrupts: Not executable.
modules.memory: Authoritative alias map for C0D0..C0F7, C7xx, DFxx and Page0 cache keys. Shared UI/game fields retain their mode-dependent lifetimes.
modules.reuse: Native adapter contract. Other hosts provide equivalent aliases or replace this file at assembly time; no allocator is implied.

modules.inputs: Resident entry; generated cold/startup banks, player seed and main Page0 segment available.
modules.outputs: Loads existing Page0 cold/startup code, optionally replays boot, restores native bitmap scratch/seed/audio and tail-enters GameSession_UI.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI; a lifecycle transition, not a short returning helper.
modules.interrupts: Cold initialization owns display/IRQ state; no active-frame invocation.
modules.memory: Existing cold 1400..1FFF, startup 2900..2FFF and native D300..F2FF lifetimes; no extra segment or buffer.
modules.reuse: Game-specific bootstrap binding. Retain relocation sizes, seed and scratch restoration; it is not a generic loader.

modules.inputs: Current Full_Layout/fx/phase; prewarm additionally requires camera, exact HUD/boundary/flag/label tables and display off.
modules.outputs: Selects the existing phase/theme bank; Boundaries restores phase bank. Prewarm initializes all eight physical cache keys and glyph sets.
modules.registers: MapEdges AF/DE/HL scratch; PhaseBank AF scratch; other entries common caller-saved ABI.
modules.interrupts: Prewarm is cold-only; VDP helpers retain their DI/EI behavior. Active helpers keep current foreground mapper ownership.
modules.memory: Existing cache key state and eight 16 KiB pattern/color sets; no new RAM/VRAM or transfer staging.
modules.reuse: Full-session packed-layout binding. Supply matching phase/theme resources; never prewarm a visible set during gameplay.

modules.inputs: Main Page0 segment mapped. LoadKind selects new board, next round or restored player. Native state/tables and generated world banks are installed. PhaseSelect takes A=new phase, with phase holding that same value; its result is written to pattern_back and the existing lookup cache, not returned as an A bank argument.
modules.outputs: Allocates the established segment identities, restores round/map/flags/sprites and existing video lifecycle. PhaseSelect excludes the visible set and updates pattern_back.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI. PhaseSelect preserves IX/IY; shared-sprite helper retains its adjacent carry/result contract.
modules.interrupts: Cold loading may DI/EI and block with audio silenced/display hidden. PhaseSelect runs foreground; it is not a map-building call.
modules.memory: Existing main segment, two 16 KiB map segments, normal/hidden flag segments, native seed and exact cache metadata. No additional segment is allocated by extraction.
modules.reuse: Native map/round adapter. Cold world initialization composes the already independent phase selector and shared-sprite helpers; they remain separately includable through their existing files.

modules.inputs: Cold mode transition; main Page0, native seed, world/HUD resources and renderer aliases valid.
modules.outputs: SCREEN4 registers/palette, terrain/cache/HUD/sprite restoration, first commit and ready latch; returns EI.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI.
modules.interrupts: Owns cold DI/EI and display-enable sequence; must not run concurrently with active presentation.
modules.memory: Existing popup invalidation, terrain, eight pattern sets, two name tables and sprite areas; no new buffers.
modules.reuse: Host-specific mode/palette/restoration policy; replace this binding for another viewport/resource layout instead of adding a runtime branch.

modules.inputs: Cold round flag records, phase/name tables, scratch and independent flag segments initialized.
modules.outputs: Builds exact 64-phase radar glyph/name caches and invalidates loaded keys; native positions/rules remain unchanged.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI.
modules.interrupts: Cold build only; runtime capture invalidation uses the existing session-flags API rather than rebuilding all phases.
modules.memory: Existing flag records, CE80 staging, radar scratch and dedicated flag RAM segments; no extra cache.
modules.reuse: Game-specific flag encoding/geometry. The caller must preserve native record layout and cache generation semantics.

modules.inputs: Native session/player/attract state, main Page0 and generated UI/native bank bindings.
modules.outputs: Existing menu, challenge, death/restart, round and alternating-player transitions; returns or tail-enters the original state machine.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI.
modules.interrupts: Owns blocking cold UI HALT/display/DI/EI sequence. Never call as an IRQ service or renderer callback.
modules.memory: Existing session/native/UI aliases and their cold/game lifetimes.
modules.reuse: Game-specific policy with direct native entry calls. Supply another assembly-time policy for another game.

modules.inputs: Main Page0. Tick derives elapsed ticks from clock_ticks/Audio_LastUI, not an A bank argument. Event only handles the established background request; native request RAM drives other sounds.
modules.outputs: Pinned PSG worker runs at elapsed 30 Hz cadence; worker calls restore GAME_NATIVE_BANK. Turbo entries remain no-op RETs.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI across mapped Audio_RuntimeStep; Event AF scratch.
modules.interrupts: No new DI/EI; IRQ must not write PSG or change Page2 mapping while the worker runs.
modules.memory: Existing D150 audio timing state and E9xx native audio requests/caches; score bytes in AUDIO_BANK.
modules.reuse: Native WSG-to-PSG binding. Mutually exclusive with audio-first-stage; these public label names have different input/event semantics.

modules.inputs: Native player/event/camera state, current pattern phase and decor bank. Run AfterFrame after native simulation; names/overlay/uploads follow the existing renderer order.
modules.outputs: Exact player label and score inscriptions through existing dirty/lazy caches; demo completion follows native lifecycle.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI.
modules.interrupts: Foreground only; VDP helpers keep existing latch ownership. No new per-frame polling or transfer is added.
modules.memory: Existing DFE4..DFEA popup state, 2880 keys and shared UI/game scratch. UI/video restoration invalidates stale popup state.
modules.reuse: Game-specific event/label format. Rebind at assembly time; do not reuse UI scratch while a gameplay popup owns it.

modules.inputs: Native player/movement/wall fields, Session_GuardActive and the established pre-step snapshot. Save before native motion; Validate after motion.
modules.outputs: Preserves accepted primary movement or restores the previous native motion snapshot; no wall bypass. DisplayRound is a display-only accessor and never advances the round.
modules.registers: Common caller-saved ABI across native calls; DisplayRound preserves BC/DE/HL and returns its existing biased/capped value in A.
modules.interrupts: Foreground only, no added synchronization; native motion and input sampling order remain required.
modules.memory: Existing D200..D222 motion snapshot and native E0xx fields; no extra input or movement buffer.
modules.reuse: Native gameplay policy. Keep original native movement/wall entry points and snapshot encoding; use another compile-time adapter for another game.

modules.inputs: SpecialFrame reads physical clock. RadarColor: HL=pattern byte, adjacent color row, IX identifies native actor; caller draws player last.
modules.outputs: Latched blink phase and existing yellow-flag/player color priority; returns HL to the pattern row.
modules.registers: SpecialFrame AF/HL scratch. RadarColor AF/HL scratch with final pattern-row HL, BC preserved; DE/IX/IY untouched.
modules.interrupts: IFF unchanged; foreground cache edit, no VDP port traffic here.
modules.memory: Existing GameSession_Blink byte and caller-owned radar pattern/color row.
modules.reuse: Binding to the accepted SCREEN4 colors and native actor identity; not a general palette compositor.

modules.inputs: Stop: main native audio RAM valid. CompletionWait: tail-called from native Round_Tick state 1 with native bank/main Page0 already mapped; regular pause gate surrounds it.
modules.outputs: Stop silences real PSG, clears effect debt and invalidates cache while preserving native melody request. Completion yields until original settlement/audio-ready condition, then tail-enters bonus.
modules.registers: Stop AF/BC/DE/HL scratch. CompletionWait AF/HL scratch until its existing tail call.
modules.interrupts: IFF unchanged; no HALT/spin, extra state or bank switch in CompletionWait. IRQ must not compete for PSG.
modules.memory: Existing E9xx native audio cache, native round clock/state and Audio_LastUI; no additional state.
modules.reuse: Native event pacing/PSG binding; preserve request completion semantics rather than replacing them with a delay.

modules.inputs: Call once after cold initialization with shared startup bank mapped at 8000; generated opcode 0..4 replay descriptors and palette supplied.
modules.outputs: Native-timeline cold replay or consumed skip key; returns EI, PSG silent, R15=0 and regular BLACK border. Caller restores native scratch/seed/audio.
modules.registers: AF/BC/DE/HL/IY and Page2 bank caller-saved; main Page0 segment retained.
modules.interrupts: Cold UI IRQ scans keys. No active-game calls. HARDWARE_CHECK=0 omits resources, code and gate at build time.
modules.memory: Existing 2900..2FFF worker, C0F8..C0FC state, D300 descriptors and two VRAM pages; no full decoded bitmap buffer.
modules.reuse: Reusable replay codec only with matching generated descriptors/timing/skip policy. Include removal must use the existing generator selection contract.
